dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Well, well, these trees and plants really look the part, don't they? For a moment there, I thought we were at Kinich's home.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Feeling homesick? Moved to tears? Go ahead, let it out, you can ugly cry here! And hey, maybe if you ask your friends nicely, they'll make you a nice mountain to rest your little head so you can live here forever!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: That still leaves the problem of where to put you. And this place is far too pleasant for a Saurian who just earned himself another timeout.
